\cos 10^\circ+\sqrt3\sin 10^\circ=2\cos 50^\circ=2\sin 40^\circ

So
\[
2\sin\alpha\sin 40^\circ=\cos 10^\circ=\sin 80^\circ=2\sin 40^\circ\cos 40^\circ.
\]
Dividing by \(2\sin 40^\circ\):
\[
\sin\alpha=\cos 40^\circ=\sin 50^\circ.
\]
Since \(\alpha\) is acute, \(\alpha=50^\circ\).
